summary: Nora can answer where someone has been — today, usually, repeatedly — from the household's derived presence history.
details: A new read-only tool, where_been, answers a day's trips and stops, usual places, weekly rhythm, or repeated routes through the same location-sharing disclosure rule as where_is.
An unlabeled place stays unlabeled: Nora will not invent a home or workplace from a pattern that has not earned a name.
Answers carry their window (past N days, or the named date) and never include raw coordinates or a corridor's road sequence.
limitations: The tool is not granted to the Dreamer: derived presence is not folded into standing memory or quoted unprompted.
There is no anomaly arm yet — unusual-late or unusual-day questions still have no derived event to read.
